`PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR` repository at commit
`2661c7c0ef5c613e8f93c6e93b2e052399f0f854`.

- Upstream URL: `https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR/blob/2661c7c0ef5c613e8f93c6e93b2e052399f0f854/docs/datasets/images/ch_doc1.jpg`
- Decoded SHA256: `19588f23a55ded05245de1fcfdfe2425b1ee913522d16d743d4f04306b878dee`
- Expected text: `如，和对旅游表演形式`
